item: 3 — the twin's DB half through the deployed rail
premise_under_test: Fable, CAL-P079 item 3: the twin's DB half is 'now runnable through the deployed rail'. CAL-P078 reported it unmeasurable on blocked TCP 5432 and was told the rail is the sanctioned path.
verdict: FALSIFIED — the rail executes the statement but cannot afford it

what_is_NOT_the_blocker.guard: PASSES on every attempt. `assert_read_only` admits a leading WITH on the row path (`_READ_PREFIXES = ('SELECT','WITH')`); the refusal of leading WITH applies only to `analyze`.
what_is_NOT_the_blocker.semicolons: The fold carries 15 `;`, ALL inside `--` comments. `assert_read_only` scans raw text with no comment-awareness, so they must be stripped — done with a quote-state-aware left-to-right scanner, not a regex, because apostrophes in the prose comments ("can't", "Alex's") desynchronise any naive quote tracker. 0 semicolons in code; verified independently.
what_is_NOT_the_blocker.bind_params: `[[:space:]]` does NOT become a SQLAlchemy bind param. text()'s regex is `(?<![:\w$])(:\w+)(?!:)` and the trailing `:` of the POSIX class fails the negative lookahead. No escaping needed.

the_blocker.mechanism: The row path hardcodes `SET LOCAL statement_timeout = '10s'` (app/routes/admin_data_quality.py, row path) and explicitly REFUSES `timeout_ms` unless `explain: true` ('`timeout_ms` is only supported with `explain: true`').
the_blocker.why_that_can_never_fit: The twin's own DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS is 240000 (240 s), and CAL-P077's comparable 49-cell sweep took 364.4 s. A 10 s budget is not a tight fit that better SQL would clear — it is two orders of magnitude short of what the instrument was built expecting.
the_blocker.why_the_explain_path_is_not_a_substitute: It caps at 25 s (still short), `assert_executable_for_analyze` refuses a leading WITH, and it returns a PLAN, not the fold's result rows. The bound needs rates, not costs.

attempts.note: A real datum, not a failure: there are no resolved futures_markets rows with source='odds_api'. The sportsbook curve reaches the payload under other source labels (see the two-moneyline-sources finding). It also proves the partitioned statement is mechanically well-formed and fast when the population is empty.

The decisive one. Partitioning by (source, category) is fold-preserving — every CTE derives from market_info and every join is source- or market-keyed, and vm_stats already groups by category — so this is the SMALLEST honest chunk. It still does not fit. Chunking is therefore not a workaround; there is no chunk size that both fits 10 s and remains a cell of the published fold.

timing_anomaly_recorded_not_explained: The full-population and kalshi attempts elapsed ~28-30 s against a declared 10 s budget, while the (source, category) chunk elapsed 10.5 s. Recorded rather than theorised: `SET LOCAL` outside an explicit transaction block applies only to the statement it accompanies and is otherwise discarded, so the effective budget on the heavier statements may be a server default rather than the 10 s the code asks for. Either way both are far below 240 s and the conclusion does not turn on which.

what_this_does_and_does_not_block.does_NOT_block_the_bound: `tolerance_pp()` reads ONLY the payload's `staged` block (units_banked, units_drifted, units_drift_unknown). It needs no database. Gate 0's BOUND is therefore fully measurable from the published payload alone, and is reported in bound-timeline.json.
what_this_does_and_does_not_block.does_block_the_verdict: `reconcile()` needs db_cells to classify buckets into compared / outside / db_only / published_only. With zero db_cells the instrument correctly refuses to say 'agrees' and returns `unmeasurable` — which is the designed behaviour, not a defect, and is exactly what CAL-P078's first run recorded.

fix_shapes_for_routing_not_applied_here: Allow `timeout_ms` on the ROW path with the same 500 ms-25 s bound the explain path already carries. One-line, still bounded — but 25 s is very likely still short of this fold, so it fixes the API asymmetry without fixing this measurement.

Run the twin IN-DYNO where its own 240 s budget applies. This is the shape that actually fits, and `program/calibration-75` already ships the module and the script; it needs a task or admin entry point to be reachable from outside a shell.
Neither is applied on this branch. The measurement is the deliverable; the fix is a decision.
